Devotion 1.0.2-test1 (2026-07-18) - tempering CTD test build
=============================================================

WHAT THIS BUILD CHANGES
The crash some of you hit while tempering/crafting on 1.0.1 has been traced
to the game engine's own "Craft Item" story event delivery. This build stops
using that path entirely: crafting detection now comes through powerofthree's
Papyrus Extender (already a requirement), which delivers the same information
without the crash-prone engine path.

INSTALL
1. Replace your current Devotion install with this zip (same as any update).
   Safe to install mid-save. Do NOT start a new game unless you want to.
2. Load your save. If you use the same save that crashed before, even better.
3. Open the console (~ key) and type:

       set PDV_GLO_DebugLevel to 1

   then press ~ again to close. This turns on the one log line we need. You
   can check it took with:  GetGlobalValue PDV_GLO_DebugLevel
   When you are done testing, set it back to 0 the same way.

   You also need Papyrus logging enabled. In your Skyrim.ini (or
   SkyrimCustom.ini), under [Papyrus]:

       bEnableLogging=1
       bEnableTrace=1

   The log then appears at:
   Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\Logs\Script\Papyrus.0.log

WHAT TO TEST (in rough priority order)
1. TEMPER: stand at a grindstone with several weapons and temper them
   back-to-back, as fast as the menu allows. This was the crash trigger.
   Do the same at an armor workbench.
2. COOK: cook a few things at a cookpot.
3. SMITH: forge a new item at a forge. If you play an Orc, check you still
   get Malacath forge credit.
4. ENCHANT + ALCHEMY: make one of each.
5. Keep playing normally for a session.

WHAT TO REPORT BACK
- Whether tempering still crashes (and if so, attach the new crash log from
  Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE or your crash logger's
  output folder, plus Papyrus.0.log).
- IMPORTANT - "no crash" is only half the test. Please also confirm crafting
  still EARNS piety, and check tempering separately from creating:
    a) note your piety in the Book of Days,
    b) TEMPER a few items, check whether it moved,
    c) then CREATE something new (forge an item, cook a meal) and check again.
  Tempering and creating are detected by the same new hook, but only creating
  is guaranteed to have been exercised in testing. If tempering stops earning
  piety while creating still works, that is a real bug worth reporting even
  though nothing crashed.
- Your MCM should now show version "1.0.2-test1" (System/About page). If it
  still says 1.0.0 or 1.0.1, the install did not take.
- Please send Papyrus.0.log from the test session. Search it for the word
  "Item crafted" - those lines are the ones we need. They look like:

      [PDV] PlayerEvents: Item crafted: bench=12345, createdItem=0

  A line with createdItem=0 after you TEMPER something is the result we are
  hoping for. No line at all after tempering is the problem case.
- The exact size in bytes of your installed Devotion.esp
  (right-click > Properties). It should be 646,823 bytes for this build.

THANK YOU
Your crash logs from 1.0.1 are what proved the first fix wasn't enough and
pointed at the real cause. This one removes the crashing code path outright
rather than patching around it.
